question: The book 'Kashmir's Untold Story : Declassified' was written by :

options.text: Iqbal Chand Malhotra and Maroof Raza
C Uday Bhaskar and G D Bakshi

solution:
The correct answer is __**Iqbal Chand Malhotra and Maroof Raza**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iqbal Chand Malhotra** had completed their **degree in Economics from ****Queens College, University of Cambridge.**
 
• As of August 2022, **Iqbal Chand Malhotra is Chairman & Producer, AIM Television Pvt. Ltd.**
 
• **Iqbal Chand Malhotra** also worked as an **advisor to India to media mogul Rupert Murdoch**.
 
• **Maroof Raza** was a **former Indian Army officer and commentator on military and security issues**.
